description:
£135 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this well-presented first-floor maisonette in the popular area of Sandyford.

Ideally located within walking distance of both Newcastle and Northumbria Universities, the property also offers convenient access to Newcastle City Centre and its range of local amenities. Fully furnished throughout, the accommodation comprises six bedrooms, two bathrooms, a comfortable lounge and a well-appointed kitchen, providing plenty of space for student living.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
